name: regex-callback
objective:
PUBLIC BEHAVIOR: Extend replace_regex so a replacement callable receives the framework's immutable RegexMatch (including groups, named groups and character offsets), and its returned string is substituted. Keep string replacements/backreferences, count limits, flags, compiled patterns, no-match behavior and the existing public functions unchanged. Preserve callback exceptions, without wrapping them.
COMPATIBILITY: Existing str replacement calls and compiled-pattern flag errors must retain behavior. Do not redefine existing match APIs.
QUALITY: Existing tests, independent callback/string/exception assertions, strict typing, Ruff and formatting must all pass. Multiple implementations are legitimate; retain the documented callback contract. Investigate related symbols and tests before editing.
oracle:
from devtools.core.regex import RegexMatch, replace_regex
import re
seen=[]
def callback(match):
    assert isinstance(match, RegexMatch), "callback must receive framework RegexMatch"
    seen.append(match)
    return match.named_group("word").upper()
assert replace_regex("a é", r"(?P<word>\w+)", callback)=="A É"
assert [m.span for m in seen]==[(0,1),(2,3)]
assert seen[1].groups==("é",)
assert replace_regex("a a", "a", lambda m:"b", count=1)=="b a"
assert replace_regex("A a", re.compile("a", re.I), lambda m:m.value.lower())=="a a"
assert replace_regex("xyz", "a", lambda m:1/0)=="xyz"
assert replace_regex("a1", r"(a)(1)", r"\2\1")=="1a"
assert replace_regex("a", "a", "b")=="b"
try: replace_regex("a", re.compile("a"), "b", flags=re.I)
except ValueError: pass
else: raise AssertionError("compiled flags contract lost")
sentinel=RuntimeError("callback failure")
def fail(match): raise sentinel
try: replace_regex("a", "a", fail)
except RuntimeError as error: assert error is sentinel
else: raise AssertionError("callback exception swallowed")
print("9 callback and compatibility scenarios passed")
